question: I'm an IS sophomore (P-013) on academic warning. I want to register for both 67-272 and 67-373 in Spring 2026. I see both are listed in the schedule. Can I take them together?

domain_contributions.courses: 67-373 requires 67-272 at least D — P-013 has NOT yet completed 67-272, making 67-373 ineligible regardless of the schedule
domain_contributions.schedules: Both 67-272 and 67-373 are offered Spring 2026; however, 67-272 Sec4 (Mon/Wed 08:30-09:45) and 67-373 SecW (Mon 08:30-09:45) also share a time slot, creating an additional conflict

key_facts: 67-373 prerequisite: 67-272 at least D — P-013 has NOT completed 67-272 yet
67-272 offered Spring 2026: Sec4 Mon/Wed 08:30-09:45, SecW Thu 08:30-10:20, SecX Thu 10:30-12:20
67-272 Sec4 (Mon 08:30-09:45) and 67-373 (Mon 08:30-09:45) are at the exact same time — additional conflict even if prereq were met
P-013 should take only 67-272 in Spring 2026 and can take 67-373 in a future semester after completing 67-272
wrong_if_single_domain: Checking only the schedule might confirm both are offered and even warn about a time conflict in certain sections — but misses that the course prerequisite alone blocks 67-373. Checking only prerequisites correctly identifies the blocker but misses the schedule conflict information useful for future planning.
common_mistake: Seeing both courses listed in the Spring 2026 schedule and assuming they can both be registered for; not checking that 67-373 has 67-272 as a hard prerequisite
reasoning_chain: Step 1: Check 67-272 prereqs → 15-121 D ✓, 67-262 D ✓ — P-013 eligible for 67-272
Step 2: Check 67-373 prereqs → requires 67-272 D — P-013 does NOT have 67-272 → BLOCKED
Step 3: Schedule check → 67-272 Sec4 and 67-373 SecW both Mon 08:30-09:45 → also a conflict
Conclusion: P-013 can only take 67-272 in Spring 2026; 67-373 must wait until after 67-272 is completed
